name: CoA woodworking catalog: item appearance rows only for owned items
contract: Every SMSG_PATCH_ITEM_APPEARANCES (0x0693) row makes the Extensions DLL rebuild the client's whole item
appearance index, so the login woodworking catalog sends a row only for an item the character owns.
Sturdy Polearm 808974 is crafted by Woodworking and has no appearance of its own, so the catalog carries its row.
A character owning no woodworking item receives none at login. Obtaining the polearm sends its row once; a
second copy sends nothing. After a relog the owned polearm's row is in the login catalog again.
The packet count is per actor and is not reset by the relog.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: no woodworking row at login for a character that owns none
Obtaining Sturdy Polearm sends its row
A second polearm does not send the row again
After a relog the owned polearm's row is in the login catalog
